description: This file implements a factory class for creating MongoDB query builders with specific limits or unlimited configurations, utilizing the Criteria and LimitsConfig objects.

classes.name: MongoQueryBuilderFactory
classes.description: Immutable factory class for creating MongoDB query builder instances with or without limits, based on provided criteria and configuration.

methods.name: MongoQueryBuilderFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with a LimitsConfig instance.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new limited QueryBuilder instance based on provided criteria, respecting max and default page sizes from limitsConfig.

methods.name: newUnlimitedBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new unlimited QueryBuilder instance based on provided criteria.

methods.name: checkCriteria
methods.description: Static method to ensure the provided Criteria object is not null, throwing an exception if it is.
